description: System test of storyboard-batch.py — one frame, two founders + bowed micro excavator.

frames.prompt:
Warm celebratory documentary photograph, 9:16 vertical.

Persistent characters: the two DiggerLid founders, two real Australian tradesmen — preserve their faces exactly from the reference portraits. Founder A: broad-shouldered, neatly-trimmed dark moustache, wearing his black baseball cap. Founder B: slimmer build, thick full chevron moustache, mid-brown side-parted hair, no cap, clean-shaven cheeks and chin.

[Context] System test image — the two founders next to a brand-new machine.
[Visual] The two DiggerLid founders standing side-by-side, directly next to a brand-new compact micro excavator. The micro excavator is spotless and factory-fresh — glossy yellow paintwork gleaming, tracks clean, not a speck of dust. Sitting on top of the excavator cab roof is an enormous celebratory gift bow, like a car-dealership delivery bow — big looping ribbon, bright and festive. Both founders grin broadly at the camera, proud and stoked, one resting a hand on the machine. Navy work shirts with sleeves rolled. Clean bright workshop or driveway setting, soft natural daylight.
[Format] 9:16 vertical aspect ratio.
[Style] Warm documentary photography, hyperreal detail on the founders' faces and the machine, celebratory mood, natural light. No text or watermark.
